data.name: Hanzilah
data.gender_notes: Hanzilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Her name means "giver of delight". It is derived from the Arabic word "hanzala" which means "to delight". The name suggests someone who brings joy and happiness to others. The name Hanzilah carries the meaning “Delightful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hanzilah usually hope their child will grow to embody delightful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Hanzilah is a reminder of the divine pleasure that comes from fulfilling the will of Allah. It encourages the bearer to seek joy in serving others and in pleasing Allah.
data.etymology: Hanzilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delightful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hanzilah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
